incomeLabel: Published family-income ceiling: ₹2.5 lakh/year; verify current State/UT notification
benefit: Compulsory non-refundable fees plus academic allowance. The allowance varies by course group and hosteller/day-scholar status; do not assume a fixed amount.
checks: Confirm the current-year income ceiling and State/UT implementation rules.
Check that your institution and course are covered and correctly mapped on the portal.
Course group and hosteller/day-scholar status affect the admissible amount.

n: Central Sector Scholarship of Top Class Education for SC Students
benefit: Eligible tuition fee and non-refundable charges, plus academic allowance under the 2026–27 scheme guidelines. Private-institution fee caps and notified-institution rules apply; check the current guideline before relying on any amount.
docs: Admission proof from a notified / empanelled institution
checks: For study beyond Class XII in an institution notified / empanelled under the scheme.
The institute list and available slots for 2026–27 are decisive; admission to any college is not enough.
Confirm the current guideline for eligible courses, fee caps, academic allowance and family restrictions.

n: PM-YASASVI Top Class College Education for OBC, EBC and DNT Students
benefit: Full financial support for eligible prescribed courses in notified institutions, subject to institute-wise slots, course rules and current scheme guidelines.
docs: OBC / EBC / DNT category certificate as applicable
Admission proof from a notified institution
checks: For OBC, EBC and DNT students admitted to a full-time prescribed course in an institution notified for the scheme.
Family income from all sources must be within ₹2.5 lakh/year under the cited guidelines.
Awards are limited by institution-wise slots and inter-se merit; eligibility does not guarantee selection.
Check the 2026–27 institution list and slot allocation before applying.

n: Post-Matric Scholarship Scheme for ST Students
by: Ministry of Tribal Affairs / State & UT Governments
benefit: Compulsory fees subject to State/UT limits, plus course-dependent maintenance support. The Ministry lists a range of ₹230–₹1,200 per month; actual entitlement depends on course and applicable rules.
checks: Confirm your State/UT application route and current-year dates.
Confirm the course is recognized and the institution is eligible.
Fee reimbursement limits and maintenance amount depend on applicable rules.

n: PM-USP Central Sector Scheme of Scholarship for College and University Students (CSSS)
by: Department of Higher Education, Ministry of Education
benefit: ₹12,000 per year for the first three years of eligible undergraduate study; ₹20,000 per year at eligible later stages, subject to the current guidelines and continuation conditions.
docs: Class XII marksheet and board/stream percentile proof
checks: Fresh applicants must be above the 80th percentile of successful Class XII candidates in the relevant stream/board. Marks percentage alone does not prove this.
Fresh eligibility requires a regular course; correspondence/distance mode and diploma courses are not eligible.
Fresh applicants who took a drop after Class XII are not eligible under the cited FAQ.
Applicants must not receive another scholarship or fee reimbursement. Renewal has attendance and academic-performance conditions.

n: Post-Matric Scholarship for Students with Disabilities
by: Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities
benefit: Eligible fees, maintenance and other allowances under the scheme. Exact rates and limits depend on course, accommodation and the current detailed guidelines.
docs: UDID / benchmark disability certificate (40% or more)
checks: Benchmark disability of 40% or more is required.
UDID and the current portal consent / verification steps may be required.
The student should not receive another post-matric scholarship or stipend.
Confirm current rates, eligible course and application dates in the detailed guidelines.
